content.short: Bankless Academy is a free, open-source educational platform for Web3 knowledge.
content.description: Bankless Academy is a free, open-source educational platform that equips internet users with Web3 knowledge. It covers blockchain infrastructure, decentralized finance, and NFT technology, and provides practical guidance on personal and financial security in the Web3 space. Its core aim is to onboard newcomers to the Web3 community, helping learners build confidence and acquire skills as they explore decentralized technologies.
